segments.subtask: The robot arm is positioned near the green mat with a pink food item and a black object.
The robot arm moves towards the green mat and grasps the pink food item with the right gripper.
The robot arm lifts the pink food item and moves it towards the right basket.
The robot arm places the pink food item into the right basket.
The robot arm moves back towards the green mat to pick up the black object.
The robot arm grasps the black object with the left gripper.
The robot arm moves the black object towards the left basket and places it inside.
